name: Jannok Breezesong
summary: In Dolanaar, Jannok Breezesong trains young night elf rogues. He teaches stealth, cunning, and bladecraft to kaldorei setting out beneath the World Tree's boughs.

sections.title: A Guide in the Shadows
sections.body: Beneath Dolanaar's boughs, Jannok Breezesong teaches novice night elf rogues. He trains those who work quietly beyond the ranks of Teldrassil's sentinels and druids. His lessons teach them to stalk through shadows, strike from behind, and survive unseen among the boughs. When rogues finish their first lessons in Dolanaar, Jannok sends them to more experienced trainers in Darnassus.

faq.answer: Jannok Breezesong trains young night elf rogues in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He teaches them foundational rogue skills and techniques.

faq.q: Where does Jannok send advancing rogues?
faq.answer: After their early training in Dolanaar, rogues can travel to Darnassus for further instruction from Erion Shadewhisper, a senior rogue trainer in the city's Cenarion Enclave.

faq.q: Where can I find Jannok in Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Jannok is among Dolanaar's trainer pavilions, in the central settlement of Teldrassil outside Shadowglen.

angles.text: As a young night elf rogue starting out on Teldrassil, you can learn from Jannok in Dolanaar before heading to the capital.
As a kaldorei, you may follow the path of stealth, poisons, and daggers, alongside the traditions of sentinels and druids.
